result.question: What plan did 40 men present to priests?

readings.answer: Have the Sanhedrin ask the commander to bring Paul for a hearing so they could kill him on the way.
readings.support: you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him down to you on the pretext of examining his case more carefully. We are ready to kill him on the way.

assessments.reason: The passage says they told the priests/elders to have the Sanhedrin summon Paul and that they were ready to kill him on the way, i.e., to kill him before he reached the council.

result.reason: The text explicitly states the plan to have Paul brought to the council and kill him en route, matching “Kill Paul before council.”
